name: hudumika
description: Hudumika — Workspace platform for customs clearance, compliance, finance, and freight operations

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,tuma,lexcore,gereji,stride -c blue,green,cyan,magenta,yellow,white "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:tuma" "npm run dev:lexcore" "npm run dev:gereji" "npm run dev:stride"
scripts.dev:stride: concurrently -n stride-api,stride-web "npm run dev:stride:api" "npm run dev:stride:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/types && npm run build -w packages/ui && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.seed:qa-sso: npm run db:seed:qa-sso -w apps/api && npm --prefix tuma/tuma-web run db:seed:qa-sso && pnpm --dir ../LexCore/packages/db run seed:qa-sso && npm --prefix ../Gereji/gereji-app run db:seed:qa-sso && npm --prefix ../Stride/movara-backend run seed:qa-sso
scripts.seed:qa-sso:clean: npm --prefix ../Stride/movara-backend run seed:qa-sso:clean && npm --prefix ../Gereji/gereji-app run db:seed:qa-sso:clean && pnpm --dir ../LexCore/packages/db run seed:qa-sso:clean && npm --prefix tuma/tuma-web run db:seed:qa-sso:clean && npm run db:seed:qa-sso:clean -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && npm run check:triggers -w apps/api && npm run check:design-system && npm run check:encoding
